name: CoolBears
description:
10,000 unique CoolBears on TON. Everyone gets a bear. Not everyone gets a legend.

No real value. No financial returns. No celebrity backing. Don’t buy expecting profit. CoolBears is just for fun.

Mint will be available at https://coolbears-nfts.com

The highest-ranked CoolBear by the collection’s rarity score is reserved for the creator and excluded from public mint. Its artwork and traits remain hidden until reveal.
